profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Centripetal Networks
profile.geoLocationName: North Richland Hills, Texas, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design, develop, implement and support high-quality software build systems
Introduce new techniques and technologies for new build systems and evolve existing systems
Maintain and enhance external interfaces to build systems and information
Provide design and implementation guidance and tutoring as necessary to team members in best practices, tool use, and quality assurance
Develop build scripts and tools for builds, using most appropriate languages and technologies
Integrate automated builds and build artifacts into test environments, unit test harnesses, and code analysis tools
Manage build machines, servers, and build environments
Develop and manage an automated release packaging system
Work closely with the software team to develop new SCM strategies to support new projects

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Embedded Linux, QT, custom embedded touch based controls for industrial and commercial devices.
Linux device driver, ARM processors, RISC processors, UI development.
IOT, MQTT, Android.
Atmel, Microchip, NXP i.MX6 Series Applications Processors, Yocto Project.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Rooting, configuring, updating, programming and optimizing Android-based devices for use with
an LTE-based mobile network product based on commercial standards.

Working with Gossamer Cryptographic and Security Testing Laboratory performs FIPS 140-2
cryptographic module and cryptographic algorithm testing on OceusVPN cryptographic module.
Managed device team software development cycles from start to release. Support developers on software source control issues.
Complete setup of git server, gerrit code review server and Jenkins dailybuild server for Samsug Note2, Nexus7 and Samsung Note3.
Successful porting of LTE only features for Samsung Note2, Note3  and Nexus7.
Building custom android ROM and a secure ROM(for military use) for Galaxy note2, note3, Nexus 7 and nexus 5.
Developed SE Android policy for all android applications running on Samsung Note2 secure ROM.
Developed and modified Android applications for APN Aliases, Firewall rules, Cert Sync and Safenet VPN.
Working on Android kernel configuration. Turn on Module support for KeyDAR encryption for Android 4.2. This also included fixing Samsung Note3 power management issues.
Perform System Testing for Oceus Networks products utilizing LTE, TCP/IP, Dual VPNs and UEs
Configured Oceus Tough Mobile android phone to enable second VPN interface through kernel module.

Experiences: C, C++, Java, Python, Bash, SEAndroid, Android Application, Android Kernel, Driver, VPN, IPSEC, Cryptography, Node.js, JSON, MySQL, Android Studio, Git, Jenkins, Gerrit Code Review, Selenium

Patents: Co-Inventor of patent 9,055,163 B1 Methods of operating wireless parameter-sensing and remote host.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Languages, OS, HW & Tools Used: C++, Java, Embedded Linux, Android OS and middleware, Git,  Jenkins, OMAP3, ZOOM2, ARM, NEON, OMAP4, OMAP5, Linux Kernel 2.6.32,/3.0/3.4, Imagination POWERVR SGX540, SGX544

Working on the OMAP5430 Cortex-A15 SGX544 with Android ICS and Jelly Bean Graphics release.
Working on the OMAP4430/OMAP4460/4470 Dual-core Arm Cortex-A9 SGX544SC with Android Froyo, Gingerbread and Honeycomb Graphics release.
Debugged and tested 3D graphics drivers based on OpenGL ES 1.1 and 2.0.
Working on automation test for all the 3D graphics benchmark. This included GLBenchmark 2.1, GLBenchmark2.5, Basemark.
Optimized and tested 2-D Graphics library. The 2-D library implementation was based on the ARM/Neon CPU.
Developed and modified Android graphic benchmark applications. Well versed with Android SDK
Synchronizing, Porting and merging components between Android Eclair release to Donut release (Graphics stack Surface Flinger). Discriminately decide which changes to accept or reject in order to get a build and boot the device. The final release is targeted for a HTC mobile handset.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Languages, OS & Tools Used: Java, Javascript, Linux, Perl scripts, Python scripts, HTML, HTTP, IMS, TestMaker, CVN, SVN, Eclipse, Bugzilla, SQL,VMware, WireShark, SIPCafe.

Automation Test engineer for a fixed mobile convergence product in a multiple SIP endpoint system. This Voice over IP solution extended an enterprise-based PBX functionality into CDMA, GSM and IMS wireless networks, thus simulating a real phone and enabling the corresponding mobile number to ring when a regular desk phone is dialed. Features supported by this product included conference calling, call transfer between desk and mobile phone and call forwarding. 
Gathered requirements to create test plans.  Wrote automated test cases using TestMaker, Java and Python scripts.  Automated the following entities: callp, OAM&P on a Java-based Management Console. Windows GUI automation of the Abrazo Provisioning pages, customer log verification, and SIP messaging verification.
Performed various manual testing including callp verification on the MCS and CS1000 PBXs. Tested the Re-IP feature of single node and clustered node Abrazo server configurations all running RedHat Enterprise Linux.
Created and maintained a Java SIP library to support automation testing. Additionally, researched migration of this product for use in an LTE based environment.
Developed an SNMP Manager using Java based SNMP4J and Python for implementing statistics for enterprise server systems. 
Developed software to evaluate HTTP based Web interface to configure a fixed-mobile convergence server for subscriber provisioning, carrier server configuration and enterprise server configuration.  
Automated the process of security certificate exchange between servers for SIP based TLS links. 
Used JTAP (Java Telephony API) for testing call process in Cisco Call Manager.

positions.title: Principal Staff Engineer
positions.description:
Design, development and implementation of networking, paging, cellular and telephony applications, protocols, Unix/Linux and real-time embedded systems. 
Experience involving requirements gathering, designing, coding and testing software for cellular base stations and networks, input and output processors and other real-time embedded systems.
Worked on a variety of low level device drivers, micro-code and other software for embedded applications
Worked on LTE and 3G cellular base stations. Primarily responsible for systems engineering and architecture work for LTE eNodeB and CDMA base stations. Extensive experience designing and implementing T1/E1 spans and Ethernet, and ATM backhaul features for deployment on a network interface and switching platform. Major features include STM1, PPP, pseudo-wires, IP-RAN, AAL0 switching, AAL2/AAL5 termination and ATM to IP inter-working functions. Also involved in designing and implementing span synchronization for UMTS base stations.
Was instrumental in also implementing IP protocols for UMTS and CDMA base stations. This included working with switch ASIC and routing protocols such as OSPF to ensure Layer 2 and Layer 3 switching/routing is effectively implemented in internal and external networks.
Familiar with IMS (IP multimedia Subsystem) and Voice over IP technologies. Provide input into Motorola’s products supporting these technologies. Key contributor and one of the core members of the UMTS backhaul architecture team that focuses on future implementations of IP-RAN and IP-RANlite solutions for Motorola.
Led the development effort for providing the IMA (Inverse Multiplexing for ATM) functionality on an Interface Switching Board of the UMTS NodeB. Successfully implemented and tested the circuit emulation feature for collocation and migration of 2G and 3G base station platforms.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
C, PASCAL, Solaris, Unix, MS-DOS
          
Developed an engineering work station based application programs to promote easy integration of system tools.
Designed and implemented Netlist extractors for Mentor Graphics and Modcomp systems. Was also involved in printed circuit board placement and routing.
